title: Proxy Center
subtitle: Register your own local proxy (e.g. v2rayN); VibeHub is not a VPN and does not guarantee tunneling all traffic.
workflow: Create profiles and review connection status here; choose a default from the list, then assign a profile to each tool from its Home card.
addFirstProfile: Create a profile to select it for your tools and test its connection.
passwordStoredVault: Passwords are stored only in the Windows Credential Manager.
socksCredentialsHint: SOCKS5 authentication needs both a username and password. The handshake test checks credential negotiation and acceptance.
chooseDefaultFirst: Choose an HTTP or SOCKS5 profile as the default first.
editorProxyHint: Health checks verify VibeHub’s connection to the proxy. Each app’s traffic routing needs separate verification.
requireProxyHint: If the proxy is unavailable, launch is blocked (fail-closed at launch time). This does not guarantee all app traffic is tunneled.
tcp: 1) TCP connect to the local port
request: 3) Actual request through the selected route (optional, consent-based)
notTestable: Tests are unavailable for this profile type
testConsent: This test sends a real request to example.com. The connection and DNS may appear in the request path. Continue?
scopeNote: A healthy proxy means exactly these three tests passed — it does not mean every IDE request is tunneled.
termsNote: Some services (e.g. Freebuff) forbid using proxies to change your apparent location; respect each service's terms yourself.
credentialsInVault: Credentials are kept in the OS vault (Credential Manager).
